    **Scripts**

    -   `/users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/myscripts/admixture.R`

    **Code**

    Bash: mkdir /path, \$VCF is defining VCF designaition rather than making it text,

-   R:`list.files("pi", pattern = "windowed.pi$", full.names = TRUE)` — Finds all `*.windowed.pi` files in the `pi` folder and returns their full paths. `set_names(str_remove(basename(pi_files), fixed(".windowed.pi")))` Renames each file path to just its site code (e.g., `"BOD"`) by stripping the directory and suffix.`map_dfr(read_tsv, .id = "Population", show_col_types = FALSE)` — Reads every file and stacks them into one data frame, adding a `Population` column from the names.left_join(sites, by = "Population") %\>% mutate(Site = fct_reorder(Population, Latitude)) — Attaches latitude to each row and reorders sites north-to-south for plotting.group_by(Population, Latitude) %\>% summarise(n_windows = n(), mean_pi = mean(PI), ...) — Computes per-site window counts and mean/median nucleotide diversity.

## 10/22/2026 - Population Diversity

find pi by population, plot that in a geographical map

-   **Working Directory**

    /users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/mydata

    **Input Files**

    -   `Lottia_gigantea_flt3_sub0.01.vcf.gz`

    **Output Files**

-   /users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/myresults/pi

    **Programs and Dependenceis**

-   tidyverse

-   `r studio`

-   `vacc linux server`

-   **Scripts**

    -   /users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/myscripts/pop_diversity.R

    **Code**

    Bash:

    WINDOW=10000 ###we can change this but keep the code teh same to test multiple window sizes

    for KEEP in pops/\*.txt; do POP=\$(basename \$KEEP .txt) \# e.g. pops/BOD.txt -\> BOD echo "== \$POP ==" vcftools --gzvcf \$VCF\
    --keep \$KEEP\
    --window-pi $WINDOW \
            --out pi/$POP determines pi for 10k window frames for length of constructs in our population

    R:

    pi \<- pi_files %\>% \# name each file by its site, e.g. "pi/BOD.windowed.pi" -\> "BOD" set_names(str_remove(basename(pi_files), fixed(".windowed.pi"))) %\>% \# read every file and stack them, putting the names in a new column, Site map_dfr(read_tsv, .id = "Population", show_col_types = FALSE) %\>% left_join(sites, by = "Population") %\>% mutate(Site = fct_reorder(Population, Latitude))

-   defines pi factor and mutates in column accounting for metadata to then be plotted

    ![](myresults/pi/pi_by_site.png)

## 10/27/2026 - Signature of Selections

Find and visualize heterozygosity, pi and Taj D across populations

-   **Working Directory**

    /users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/mydata

    **Input Files**

    -   /users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/mydata/fst/\*
    -   /users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/mydata/sample_metadata.csv

    **Output Files**

-   /users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/myresults/pi

-   /users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/myresults/TajD

-   /users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/myresults/het

    **Programs and Dependenceis**

-   tidyverse

-   gcc/vcftools

-   `r studio`

-   `vacc linux server`

-   **Scripts**

    -   /users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/myscripts/sig.of.selection.R

    **Code**

    Bash:

-   vcftools --gzvcf ${VCF} \
      --weir-fst-pop pops/${POP1}.txt\
    --weir-fst-pop pops/${POP2}.txt \
      --out fst/${POP1}*vs*${POP2} \
      2> fst/${POP1}*vs*\${POP2}.log

-   POPS=( \$(cut -f2 popmap.txt \| sort -u) ) ##f extracts column, 2 extracts second column, sort -u keeps only unique values (i.e., gives you one row per pop) mkdir -p fst/pairwise echo -e "pop1\tpop2\\tmean_fst\tweighted\_fst" \> fst/pairwise_fst_summary.txt #makes empty txt file headed as pop1 etc

    for (( i=0; i\<${#POPS[@]}; i++ )); do ### starts at first row
      for (( j=i+1; j<${#POPS[\@]}; j++ )); do ###starts at second row p1=${POPS[$i]} ##i allocated to p1 (first pairwise) p2=${POPS[$j]} ##j allocated to p2 (second pairwise) vcftools --gzvcf ${VCF} \
          --weir-fst-pop pops/${p1}.txt\
    --weir-fst-pop pops/${p2}.txt \
          --out fst/pairwise/${p1}*vs*${p2} \
          2> fst/pairwise/${p1}*vs*${p2}.log ##same vcftools code as above but looped through
        mean=$(grep "mean Fst" fst/pairwise/${p1}_vs_${p2}.log \| awk '{print $NF}') ##extracts the mean FST through each loop using grep
        weighted=$(grep "weighted Fst" fst/pairwise/${p1}_vs_${p2}.log \| awk '{print \$NF}') ##also the weighted

-   pairwise then nested loop fst population compairisons: extracts metadata, runs comparison, outputs statsistics

-   **Working Directory**

    **Programs and Dependenceis**

-   tidyverse

-   `r studio`

-   `vacc linux server`

-   **Scripts**

    -   /users/k/i/kirobert/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/myscripts/BayPass.R
    -   

    ![](myresults/baypass_top_lat_snp.png)

<!-- -->

-   **Code**

covariates \<- readLines("baypass/Lottia.baypass.covariates.txt")

bf \<- read.table("baypass/Lottia_bp_summary_betai_reg.out", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE) %\>% rename(BF_dB = `BF(dB)`) %\>% mutate(covariate = covariates[COVARIABLE]) %\>% left_join(snps, by = "MRK") %\>% add_genome_pos()

bf %\>% group_by(covariate) %\>% summarise(n_decisive = sum(BF_dB \> 20))

ggplot(bf, aes(x = genome_pos / 1e6, y = BF_dB)) + geom_point(aes(colour = shade), size = 0.6) + geom_point(data = filter(bf, BF_dB \> 20), colour = "red", size = 1) + geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed") + facet_wrap(\~ covariate, ncol = 1) + scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey35", "grey70"), guide = "none") + labs(x = "Genome pos (Mb)", y = "Bayes factor (dB)") + theme_classic()

ggsave(paste0(OUTDIR,"/baypass_bf_scan.png"), width = 10, height = 6)

makes manhattan plot of an significant genome wide SNP covariate pairs.
